title: fix(service-storage): key an upload by a sanitised basename, so a file name with slashes no longer nests directories
body:
Fixes #32167

Clause-②: no
Metadata-protocol: none

## 维护者速读

- 改了什么:上传文件的存储键(storage key)不再从客户端文件名里原样截取"扩展名";只取文件名最后一段(去掉 `/` 与 `\` 之前的部分)的扩展名,且仅当它是 1–16 个 ASCII 字母或数字时保留。所有生成存储键的入口(预签名上传、分片上传、服务端附件、记录上传链接、复用文件时的拷贝、旧数据回填)统一走同一个函数。预签名上传入口顺带拒绝非字符串的 `filename`(400)。
- 为什么改:文件名 `../../etc/passwd` 过去会生成键 `user/ID./etc/passwd`,虽没逃出存储根目录,但用户输入决定了存储目录结构,S3/本地驱动会把它变成真实的嵌套目录。
- 风险与回滚:只影响新生成的键,已存储的键不迁移、读取方一律读已存储的键。回滚即 revert 本 PR。非常规扩展名(中文、带空格或标点、超过 16 字符)的新文件键将不带扩展名,原始文件名仍完整保存在文件记录的 `name` 上,下载与列表显示不受影响。
- 先看:`packages/services/service-storage/src/storage-key.ts`(新的唯一键生成函数);`storage-routes.ts` 预签名入口的 `typeof filename` 拒绝分支;`file-reference-lifecycle.ts` 的 `copyOwnedFile` 改为调用同一函数。
- 两分钟验证:`pnpm --filter @objectstack/service-storage exec vitest run src/storage-key.test.ts src/storage-routes.test.ts` —— 预期全部通过,含 `Upload doors: a file name carrying separators keys flat inside the storage root` 一组。
- 需要你做的:无,席位落地。

## What changes

- **One key builder.** `buildKey(scope, fileId, filename)` moves to a new import-free module `packages/services/service-storage/src/storage-key.ts`, with the helper `storageKeyExtension(filename)`: take the basename (everything up to the last `/` or `\` dropped), take its last dot segment, and keep it only when it is 1 to 16 ASCII letters or digits; otherwise the key has no extension. `storage-routes.ts` imports it and re-exports it, so its three existing importers (`field-file-service.ts`, `file-attachment-service.ts`, `record-file-access.ts`) are untouched.
- **Every key builder routes through it.** The presigned and chunked doors and the three importers already called `buildKey`. Two more sites re-derived a new key from a stored name with the same raw shape, and now call it too: `copyOwnedFile` in `file-reference-lifecycle.ts` (live: a record writing a file id that another field slot owns) and the legacy data-URI backfill in `backfill-file-references.ts`. Both are in this package and the same defect class, and the fix is mechanical. They are declared here as an addition to the claim's file surface (the bounded in-place fix: same class, mechanical, no other claim holds the files, same gate family).
- **The presigned door refuses a non-string `filename`** with `400 INVALID_REQUEST`, before any row is written, as `GetPresignedUrlRequestSchema` (`filename: z.string().min(1)`) already declares. Measured before the change, with the old derivation planted back: a number or an object answered `500 INTERNAL` (the key build threw), and an array answered `200` and stored `["a.png"]` as the file's `name`. With the new helper the array case would also have thrown, so this change touched that defect and fixes it. The chunked sibling already parses its body with its declared schema.
- **Drivers.** S3 and local do not derive keys: both receive the key the routes built. There is one derivation seam, and the driver-level `storageKey()` in the S3 adapter only applies the configured prefix.
- **Not migrated.** Existing keys keep their shape. No reader re-derives a key from a name; every reader reads `sys_file.key`.
- The client's original name stays on the file record as `name`, which downloads (`Content-Disposition`) and listings use.

**Clause-② judgment.** The declaration line stays `no` (the claim's line, copied). The one refusal this PR adds is input the published declaration already refused. The presigned door was the outlier, answering 200 for an array and 500 for a number or object, while its declaration and its chunked sibling refuse all three. Nothing a caller can write under the published accept set is refused, and nothing is widened.

**Rulings on this surface.** The dispatch's grep for ruling, Ruling-ref, maintainer and the stop-sign marker, run over every file this PR touches, finds 15 hits. None concerns key derivation or the file name:

## Tests

- `src/storage-key.test.ts` (new): `../../etc/passwd`, `a/b/c.png`, `a\b\c.png`, a Windows absolute path, a separator or backslash after the last dot, and `x.png/../..` each key as `user/fid` or `user/fid.png`, with exactly one `/` and no `\`. The charset and length bound is checked against a trailing dot, a space, a control character, a non-ASCII extension, punctuation, 17 characters, `.`, `..` and empty, with 16 characters as the control.
- `src/storage-routes.test.ts`, new top-level describe `Upload doors: a file name carrying separators keys flat inside the storage root`. Presigned (end to end through the `_local/raw` PUT, then reading the storage root on disk: exactly one regular file under `user/`) and chunked init, for the three names the dispatch named. Each also asserts the record's `name` keeps the client's name.
- `src/storage-routes.test.ts`, `POST /upload/presigned`: `REFUSED 400 INVALID_REQUEST: filename as a number / an array / an object, with no sys_file row written`, which asserts `error.code` and status, that the declaration refuses the body, and that `createFile` was never called.

Ablations (one-shot, through `scripts/ablation-replace.mjs`; restore verified by blob hash equal to HEAD and an empty `git diff HEAD`):

1. The old derivation planted back into `buildKey`: 6 failed / 93 passed across `storage-key.test.ts` and `storage-routes.test.ts`. The four separator-after-the-last-dot unit pins went red, plus the presigned and chunked traversal pins. The `a/b/c.png` cases stay green under the old code, because their last dot segment happens to be clean.
2. The `typeof filename` guard deleted: 3 failed / 81 passed in `storage-routes.test.ts`, exactly the three new refusal pins.

## Acceptance notes

- Main moved about 16 commits after the one `origin/main` merge (9e329bdc). The one derivation input that changed upstream, `scripts/check-verify-stand-in-erasure.mjs`, is not among this PR's derived families.
- The repo-wide `pnpm lint` is CI's run. Locally, ESLint (`--no-inline-config`) over the six changed TypeScript files exits 0.

## Verification

At head `9e329bdc` (after the `origin/main` merge):

- `pnpm --filter '@objectstack/service-storage...' build`, then `pnpm --filter @objectstack/service-storage typecheck`, then the full package suite, under the verify lock: `VERDICT command-exit 0`, `check:test-typecheck: OK`, **Test Files 78 passed (78), Tests 1466 passed (1466)**.
- `node scripts/pm/dispatch-gates.mjs --commands --repo objectstack-ai/objectstack`: 72 commands. **68 exit 0.** 4 are NOT MEASURED, each refusing on a prerequisite rather than reaching a verdict: `check-plugin-teardown-shape.mjs --self-test` (shallow clone cannot reach its pinned control), `check:dual-build-cjs-loads` and `check:i18n` (they need a whole-workspace `dist/` or the built CLI), and `check:type-check-debt` (its re-measure queued on the shared verify lock and timed out, exit 3, "NOT a pass and NOT a finding"). CI runs all four.
- Families CI owns: the PR's check-runs are the authority.
